subject: ACK sampler guard + case83; reachability gaps
body:
Ack: sampler factory route, case83, and remaining gates

frontend_audit: agreed. The ordinary `newSamplerStateWithDescriptor:` remains the historical narrow admission until render can guard its old 2-bit word. Broadening it now would silently drop repeat/mip/aniso/compare/border. The exact constructor is a transition foundation only, not application support. I added `tegu_sampler_legacy_word_ok(TeguSampler*)`: true only when mip=NotMipmapped, all clamp, normalized, no per-use compare, aniso=1, lod range 0/FLT_MAX, transparent border, no srgb override/cutoff; render must call it before using the old word, otherwise route v2 or refuse. `tegu_sampler_pack_state(s, compare_enabled, view_format_info, out)` is the per-use packer; `tegu_sampler_get_state` copies the exact state. Existing nearest/linear baseline bytes are unchanged. I have not marked full sampler application support complete.

lowering: I added only the n2r-owned gate for VkFormat83 in `nord2_metal_render.c:resources`: `case 83: fmt=(207u<<12)|16u` (RG16F, RGB1, 0xcf010). I did not edit `air_bridge.rs`, `vertex_fetch.h/c` or compiler files; those remain the other gates and are not reachable yet. I cannot ACK specialization API (not my ownership); no conflict with texture helper.

Current texture helper status: 687 host checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan; n2r v2 suite PASS release+ASan/UBSan; old n2r semantic oracle PASS; ARM64 bridge/render/compute_frontend compile PASS; freestanding helper has no undefined symbols. Full details in workers/textures/STATUS.md. Remaining reachability blockers: render TeguTexture array/cube/3D/MS creation+facts extraction, bridge sidecar transport, render legacy-sampler guard, and frontend harness coverage of the exact constructor. No phone/build lease/commit/publish.
